# bugs #3094: Warning 158 for the constant sum 24 + EXCESS that initializes an unsigned char

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3094/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17228
- Recommended action: Confirm the decision of bug #3986, apply its patch after the patch for local 0013, and close.
- Patch: [bugs-3986.patch](../../patches/bugs-3986.patch), commit [`f955bae8b`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/f955bae8b9ad37f7d01b4a986ef980754f154ce4). Apply after `local-0013.patch`.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

On r17228 for mcs51, `unsigned char exp = 24 + EXCESS;` in a function, with `EXCESS` defined as
126, gets warning 158, "overflow in implicit constant conversion", and its value 150 fits. The
assignment `exp = 24 + EXCESS;` gets the warning too. Both were compiled in the small, medium,
large, and huge models, and with `--stack-auto` in the small and large models, and both get the
warning each time. At file scope the declaration gets it in the large and huge models only. The
byte that the code stores is correct.

The library function of the ticket has `(unsigned char)24 + (unsigned char)EXCESS` since
[r12158](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/12158/), and `device/lib/__ulong2fs.c` of r17228 has
that expression. `device/lib/_ulong2fs.c` of r12157 has the statement of the ticket in line 85.
r17228 gives warning 158 for that line when it compiles the file for mcs51 with
`-D_SDCC_NO_ASM_LIB_FUNCS`, which selects the C function.

## Cause

The entry for bug #3986 describes the cause, and the second comment of this ticket agrees with
it. When a value is assigned to a char, `decorateType` in `src/SDCCast.c` casts the literal
operands of `+` to char before `valPlus` computes the constant, and an int literal becomes a
signed char. `24 + 126` becomes -106, and `checkTypes` in `src/SDCCicode.c` reports that value
for the unsigned char.

## Fix

The patch for bug #3986 fixes this ticket, and another change is not needed. `decorateType`
applies the integer promotions to two literal operands of `+` when the result type is char, and
the sum is computed in int. The patch does not change `device/lib/__ulong2fs.c`.

## Decision

The patch also adds warning 158 to constant sums, differences, and left shifts whose value does
not fit, such as `u = 200 + 100` for an unsigned char `u`. The entry for bug #3986 has the choices
that a maintainer should confirm.

## Verification

The statements under Finding were compiled for mcs51 by r17228 and by r17228 with the patches of
this report, in the six combinations of model and `--stack-auto` under Finding. With the patches
the compiler does not print a message for them, and its assembly is equal to the assembly of
r17228. The file of r12157 was compiled in the five combinations other than the huge model, and
with the patches it compiles without a message. In the huge model its definition of `__ulong2fs`
conflicts with the declaration in `float.h` of r17228, and both compilers report error 98. r17228
with the patch for bug #3986 and without the other patches was not built, and other ports were
not tested.

`support/valdiag/tests/bug-3986.c`, the test of the patch, has `u = 127 + 1` and `u = 200 + 55`
for an unsigned char `u`. It does not have the sum of this ticket.
